subject.title: fix(webhooks): keep routes cold when SecretRefs are unavailable

question: Should webhook authentication secrets move from the shipped request-time resolution contract to snapshot-only activation through secrets reload or Gateway restart?
rationale: Both designs can fail closed, but they create different credential-revocation windows and operator requirements; repository evidence establishes the tradeoff but cannot choose the intended long-term security contract.

options.title: Adopt guarded snapshot activation
options.body: Keep the PR's owner-isolated snapshot model, first skip disabled routes and add explicit rotation/revocation proof for `openclaw secrets reload`.

options.title: Preserve request-time rotation
options.body: Retain the shipped request-time secret behavior and find another way to expose typed startup diagnostics without bypassing owner isolation.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded snapshot activation
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's owner-isolated snapshot model, first skip disabled routes and add explicit rotation/revocation proof for `openclaw secrets reload`.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is connected to the current SecretRef documentation and proposed runtime direction and is the best available routing candidate for the intended credential-activation contract.
